candidate.name: stub
candidate.notes: Naive SVG reference renderer written for the harness; not a real candidate.

tipClick.how: delegated click on the tip dot or label

branchClick.how: click on a branch path; reported as branchClick with the clade below it

hover.how: mouseover on dots/branches/labels gives tipHover / nodeHover

descendantTipsInPayload.how: every event carries the descendant tips (from the shared TreeModel inside the renderer; source is reported as library because the stub renderer is the library)

cladeColouring.how: imperative stroke on the existing paths of the subtree range; no redraw, no layout change

highlightTip.how: class on the tip dot plus a row band and a ring

focusTip.how: sets row height to at least 24 px and centres the tip row; instant, no animation

tipAsLink.how: real <a href data-tip-id target=_blank> but only for rows that are rendered (rows >= 9 px); other tips have no DOM node

customColumns.how: bar, text and alignment columns drawn on one canvas for visible rows

alignmentColumn.how: coloured residue runs on the columns canvas

radialLayout.how: polar coordinates, arcs; columns are not drawn in radial layout

branchLengthToggle.how: phylogram (cumulative length) versus cladogram (tips aligned); negative lengths clamped to 0

scaleBar.how: no scale bar or time axis

darkTheme.how: gbifDarkTheme() values (derived from tokens; GBIF has no dark set) as CSS custom properties on the root element

cssTokens.how: defaults come from gbifTheme() (GBIF tokens); background, foreground, branch, highlight, fontFamily override the --sp-* custom properties

multipleInstances.how: no module state; two instances were tested via window.__spike2

cleanUnmount.how: React unmount removes the DOM; rAF cancelled; no global listeners except window pointer listeners removed on pointerup

controlledState.how: colour, highlight, focus, layout, lengths, columns, theme, links are props of the View

zoomToFit.how: fits on mount and layout change; no API to refit; wheel zoom-out is limited to 0.3x of the fit

overviewOrMinimap.how: none; every node is drawn at all zoom levels (no level of detail)

caveat: Headless Chromium without a GPU (SwiftShader software rendering): absolute FPS for canvas and WebGL candidates is pessimistic; use for functional tests and relative comparison. Final scale numbers need a real browser on a normal laptop.

thresholds.note: unusable = load > 10 s, or > 50% of the time in frames > 50 ms (best of 3 rounds), or > 100 ms main-thread CPU per interaction step, or click latency > 300 ms; p5 FPS is reported (best of 3) but not judged

load.note: os.loadavg()[0] (1-minute); runs with start or end load above 4 are marked noisy
